dedupe_keys.name: mat stocks database of economy wide material stocks in buildings infrastructure and machinery

description: MAT_STOCKS is a global country-level database of material stocks accumulated in buildings, infrastructure, machinery and other products, by four end-uses and four summary material groups, for 177 countries from 1900 to 2016. It is derived from MISO2, a dynamic inflow-driven stock-flow model covering 14 supply chain processes and 13 end-use stock types. Version 1.0.0 was published on 22 July 2024 by Wiedenhofer, Streeck, Wieland and colleagues at BOKU University and the Vienna University of Economics and Business; an EU27 extract (version 1.2.0, 2025) adds annual gross additions and end-of-life flows from 1990 to 2016. A related spatial dataset from the same group maps material stocks in all roads and rail, including tunnels and bridges, at 5 arc-minutes for 180 countries in 2021. All are available free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: stocks are modelled from material inputs and lifetimes, not surveyed. It supports condition, replacement and embodied-emission scenarios for infrastructure; a related record is the IIASA SSP scenario explorer.
